popup_sizing_and_layout.edge_to_edge_fulfillment: Ensure absolute background image covers 100% of rounded popup container without white/unfilled padding.

instructions_to_main_agent: Verify logo sparkle CSS keyframes are applied cleanly on the gold lockup container in GeoBranchGate.jsx.
Ensure dark locked backdrop prevents body scrolling when popup is active (useEffect setting body overflow to hidden).
Keep 'Sign out' button accessible at top-right of popup modal (data-testid='geo-branch-logout').
Maintain exact data-testid attributes for tests: 'geo-branch-gate', 'geo-branch-modal', 'geo-branch-options', 'geo-branch-logout', 'geo-branch-status', 'geo-branch-retry'.
Verify font-playfair, font-outfit, and font-caveat are loaded and utilized appropriately for headings, body, and handwritten accents.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All interactive buttons and cards MUST have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast_and_legibility: Selected card text must be high contrast dark (#1a160d) over gold gradient background; unselected cards must use crisp white text with backdrop-blur dark glass.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.prefers_reduced_motion: Wrap CSS sparkle animations with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to turn off looping keyframes if user prefers reduced motion.
